preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(a, int) and isinstance(b, int) and -n <= a <= n and -n <= b <= n and a != 0 and b != 0 for a, b in cards)
preconditions.description: Each card has two non-zero integers within the range [-n, n].

preconditions.expression: set(a for a, b in cards) == set(range(1, n + 1)) | set(range(-n, 0)) and set(b for a, b in cards) == set(range(1, n + 1)) | set(range(-n, 0))
preconditions.description: Every integer from 1 to n and -1 to -n appears exactly once in the front values and exactly once in the back values.

postconditions.description: The first line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0].strip().lower() == 'no' or (len(output_lines) == 2 * n + 1 and all(len(line.strip().split()) == 2 for line in output_lines[1:]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, there are exactly 2n subsequent lines, each containing two integers representing a card.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0].strip().lower() == 'no' or (set((int(x), int(y)) for line in output_lines[1:] for x, y in [line.strip().split()]) == set(cards))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, the set of cards in the output is exactly the same as the input set of cards (reordered).

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0].strip().lower() == 'no' or is_balanced([int(line.strip().split()[0]) for line in output_lines[1:]])
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, the sequence of front numbers from the ordered cards forms a balanced bracket sequence.

postconditions.expression: output_lines[0].strip().lower() == 'no' or is_balanced([int(line.strip().split()[1]) for line in output_lines[1:]])
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, the sequence of back numbers from the ordered cards forms a balanced bracket sequence.
If 'NO' is output, no valid ordering of the cards exists that satisfies the balanced condition for both sides.
